verses.title: Jesus Wants You Close
verses.text: When Jesus saw it, he was indignant and said to them, “Let the little children come to me. Don’t stop them, because the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
verses.remember: Jesus loves children and always wants you near him. You are never too little to come to Jesus.

verses.title: Come to Jesus
verses.text: Jesus said, “Leave the little children alone, and don’t try to keep them from coming to me, because the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
verses.remember: Jesus welcomes every child with open arms. There is a special place for you in God's family.

verses.title: God's Greatest Gift
verses.text: For God loved the world in this way: He gave his one and only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not perish but have eternal life.
verses.remember: God loved you so much he sent his Son, Jesus. When we believe in Jesus, we get to live with God forever.

verses.title: He Loved Us First
verses.text: We love because he first loved us.
verses.remember: God loved us before we ever loved him. His love is what teaches our hearts how to love.

verses.title: Nothing Can Separate You
verses.text: nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.remember: Nothing in the whole world can pull you away from God's love in Jesus — not ever.

verses.title: Love Like Jesus
verses.text: “This is my command: Love one another as I have loved you.
verses.remember: Jesus loves us perfectly, and he asks us to share that same love with each other.

verses.title: Loved Even on Our Worst Days
verses.text: But God proves his own love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.remember: Jesus died for us even while we were still sinners. That's how big God's love is.

verses.title: Be Brave!
verses.text: Haven’t I commanded you: be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.”
verses.remember: You can be strong and brave because God goes with you everywhere you go.

verses.title: When I'm Scared, I Trust God
verses.text: When I am afraid, I will trust in you.
verses.remember: Feeling afraid is okay. When you do, you can talk to God and trust him to take care of you.

verses.title: God Holds My Hand
verses.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will help you; I will hold on to you with my righteous right hand.
verses.remember: God promises to be with you, help you, and hold you up. You don't have to be afraid.

verses.title: Strong in Jesus
verses.text: I am able to do all things through him who strengthens me.
verses.remember: Jesus gives us strength to do hard things. We can keep going because he helps us.

verses.title: Trust God with All Your Heart
verses.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not rely on your own understanding;
verses.remember: We don't know everything, but God does. We can trust him even when we don't understand.

verses.title: God Takes Care of Me
verses.text: The Lord is my shepherd; I have what I need.
verses.remember: Like a good shepherd cares for his sheep, God gives you everything you truly need.

verses.title: God Gives Me Courage
verses.text: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but one of power, love, and sound judgment.
verses.remember: God doesn't want us to live afraid. He fills us with his power, love, and a wise, calm heart.

verses.title: God Is My Safe Place
verses.text: God is our refuge and strength, a helper who is always found in times of trouble.
verses.remember: Whenever trouble comes, God is a safe place to run to and a strong helper who is always there.

verses.title: Be Kind and Forgiving
verses.text: And be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving one another, just as God also forgave you in Christ.
verses.remember: God forgave us in Jesus, so we can be kind and forgive others too.

verses.title: A Good Friend
verses.text: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a difficult time.
verses.remember: A true friend keeps loving you all the time — on happy days and on hard days.

verses.title: The Golden Rule
verses.text: Just as you want others to do for you, do the same for them.
verses.remember: Treat other people the way you would like to be treated. That's how Jesus teaches us to love.

verses.title: The Fruit of the Spirit
verses.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control. The law is not against such things.
verses.remember: When God's Spirit lives in us, he grows good things in our hearts like love, joy, and kindness.

verses.title: Cheer Each Other On
verses.text: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up as you are already doing.
verses.remember: We can use our words to encourage our friends and help them feel strong and loved.

verses.title: Love One Another
verses.text: “I give you a new command: Love one another. Just as I have loved you, you are also to love one another.
verses.remember: Jesus gives us a special job: to love each other the same way he loves us.

verses.title: Think of Others
verses.text: Everyone should look not to his own interests, but rather to the interests of others.
verses.remember: Being kind means noticing what others need and caring for them, not just ourselves.

verses.title: Talk to God Anytime
verses.text: pray constantly,
verses.remember: Prayer is simply talking to God, and we can do it all day long, anywhere we are.

verses.title: Pray Instead of Worry
verses.text: Don’t worry about anything, but in everything, through prayer and petition with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
verses.remember: When something worries you, tell God about it and thank him. He loves to hear from you.

verses.title: Say Thank You to God
verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his faithful love endures forever.
verses.remember: God is good and his love never runs out, so we always have a reason to say thank you.

verses.title: Every Good Gift
verses.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.
verses.remember: All the good things we enjoy come from God, who loves to give and never changes.

verses.title: Do Everything for Jesus
verses.text: And whatever you do, in word or in deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
verses.remember: Whatever we say or do, we can do it to please Jesus and to say thank you to God.

verses.title: Thankful in Everything
verses.text: give thanks in everything; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
verses.remember: We can find something to thank God for every single day, because he is always with us.

verses.title: God's Peace
verses.text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.
verses.remember: When we pray, God gives our hearts a peace so wonderful it guards us like a shield.

verses.title: Obey with Love
verses.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is right.
verses.remember: God gives us parents to help us. Obeying them is one way we obey and please God.

verses.title: Honor Your Parents
verses.text: Honor your father and your mother so that you may have a long life in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.remember: Honoring your mom and dad means loving and respecting them. God gives this command with a promise.

verses.title: Listen and Learn
verses.text: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, and don’t reject your mother’s teaching,
verses.remember: Your parents teach you good things. Listening to them helps you grow wise.

verses.title: Obeying Pleases God
verses.text: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.
verses.remember: When children obey their parents, it makes God happy.

verses.title: Gentle Words
verses.text: A gentle answer turns away anger, but a harsh word stirs up wrath.
verses.remember: Kind, gentle words can calm things down, while angry words make them worse. Choose gentle words.

verses.title: Love God Most
verses.text: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength.
verses.remember: God wants us to love him with everything we have — our whole heart, soul, and strength.

verses.title: Growing in God's Way
verses.text: Start a youth out on his way; even when he grows old he will not depart from it.
verses.remember: When children learn God's good ways while young, those truths stay in their hearts as they grow.

verses.title: God Made Everything
verses.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.remember: Before anything else existed, God was there — and he made the whole world.

verses.title: Very Good!
verses.text: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good indeed. Evening came and then morning: the sixth day.
verses.remember: When God finished making the world, he saw that it was very good — and that includes you.

verses.title: Wonderfully Made
verses.text: I will praise you because I have been remarkably and wondrously made. Your works are wondrous, and I know this very well.
verses.remember: God made you on purpose and with great care. You are one of his wonderful works.

verses.title: The Sky Shows God's Glory
verses.text: The heavens declare the glory of God, and the expanse proclaims the work of his hands.
verses.remember: The sky, the stars, and the sunshine all show us how great and glorious God is.

verses.title: God Feeds the Birds
verses.text: Consider the birds of the sky: They don’t sow or reap or gather into barns, yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you worth more than they?
verses.remember: God takes care of the little birds, and he loves and cares for you even more.

verses.title: Made Through Jesus
verses.text: All things were created through him, and apart from him not one thing was created that has been created.
verses.remember: Jesus was there at the very beginning. God made everything that exists through him.

verses.title: It All Belongs to God
verses.text: The earth and everything in it, the world and its inhabitants, belong to the Lord;
verses.remember: The whole earth and everyone in it belong to God, because he made it all.

verses.theme: Faith, Joy, and Growing with Jesus
verses.title: This Is the Day!
verses.text: This is the day the Lord has made; let’s rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.remember: God made today, so we can choose to be glad and thankful in it.

verses.theme: Faith, Joy, and Growing with Jesus
verses.title: Follow God's Path
verses.text: in all your ways know him, and he will make your paths straight.
verses.remember: When we remember God in everything we do, he leads us in the right way.

verses.theme: Faith, Joy, and Growing with Jesus
verses.title: Let Your Light Shine
verses.text: In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.
verses.remember: When we do good and kind things, people see God's love and give thanks to him.

verses.theme: Faith, Joy, and Growing with Jesus
verses.title: Keep Growing
verses.text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity.
verses.remember: We grow more like Jesus as we learn about him and enjoy his kindness every day.

verses.theme: Faith, Joy, and Growing with Jesus
verses.title: God's Word Is a Light
verses.text: Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light on my path.
verses.remember: The Bible is like a flashlight that shows us the right way to go.

verses.theme: Faith, Joy, and Growing with Jesus
verses.title: Always Rejoice
verses.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
verses.remember: We can be full of joy because Jesus is with us and loves us all the time.

verses.theme: Faith, Joy, and Growing with Jesus
verses.title: Jesus Gives Rest
verses.text: “Come to me, all of you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
verses.remember: When we feel tired or sad, we can come to Jesus and he gives our hearts rest.

verses.title: A Gift from God
verses.text: Sons are indeed a heritage from the Lord, offspring, a reward.
verses.remember: Children are a gift and a reward from God. You are a blessing he gave to your family.

verses.title: A Quiver Full of Blessings!
verses.text: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the sons born in one’s youth. Happy is the man who has filled his quiver with them. They will never be put to shame when they speak with their enemies at the city gate.
verses.remember: A quiver is the bag a soldier carries his arrows in. A soldier was glad to have lots of arrows, and God says families are glad to have lots of children — so you are one of God's arrows!

verses.title: God's Good Plan for Families
verses.text: God blessed them, and God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Rule the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, and every creature that crawls on the earth.”
verses.remember: From the very beginning, God blessed families and children as part of his wonderful design.

verses.title: A Blessing Around the Table
verses.text: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house, your children, like young olive trees around your table.
verses.remember: God pictures children as a happy blessing to a family, like young trees growing around the table.

verses.title: Part of God's Family Tree
verses.text: Grandchildren are the crown of the elderly, and the pride of children is their fathers.
verses.remember: Children and grandchildren are a joy and a treasure. You are a blessing in your family.

verses.title: God Made You
verses.text: For it was you who created my inward parts; you knit me together in my mother’s womb.
verses.remember: God carefully made you before you were even born. You were his idea, and you are a gift.

verses.title: The Kingdom Belongs to Children
verses.text: Jesus, however, invited them: “Let the little children come to me, and don’t stop them, because the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
verses.remember: Jesus said God's kingdom belongs to children. You are precious and welcome to him.
